alt: The whole station from far off: a long grey cylinder with a caged forward section, radiator fields and a planet beyond.
A city district seen from street level, with pale mid-rise blocks, trees and a steel lattice rising overhead under a lit artificial sky.
The foot of the urban megaframe, with massive steel piers rising from the ground between buildings and parkland on the rotor floor.
Earth and the Moon hang in black space beside the long grey habitat, showing the station far from either world at L5.
The open industrial rotor in vacuum: tank farms, rail yards and process modules hung on a ringed steel framework with few walls.
A long spacecraft floats in a kilometre-scale steel cage, held by soft-capture rings while small tugs and manipulators work along its hull.
A wide field of flat radiator panels held out from the hull on tall mounts, edge-lit against the dark.
Solar power platforms hang in space beyond the aft end, their dark panels tilted to the Sun and linked to the station by long tethers.
A passenger craft docked at an external spaceport pier, a deep truss running out from the station into open space.
